summary: Iteration 36: validated OBS Studio panel fallback flows. Backend GET /api/stream/ingress returns configured true + rtmps url for wallowner, null ingress for wallauthor (no can_stream). Playwright verified (a) author with can_stream=true clicks obs-create-key-btn and gets a real rtmps:// url, obs-key, 'Waiting for OBS' signal light; (b) GET /api/stream/ingress forced 500 shows obs-load-error + obs-retry-btn (no infinite spinner), and retry after unroute loads panel; (c) intercept returning configured true + ingress null + error 'Could not reach LiveKit: x' shows obs-livekit-error AND obs-create-key-btn.
critical_code_review_comments: LiveKit Cloud account hit an ingress object limit (ServerError resource_exhausted, 'total ingress object limit exceeded') when author tried to create a key for the first time. Had to delete a stale ingress (IN_YV9vmigpk5Rq / skali-skalitester) via admin SDK before create succeeded. Recommend adding a backend sweeper that calls ingress.list_ingress and prunes ingresses whose ingress_id has no matching stream_ingress row in Mongo (one-shot on startup or periodic) to prevent this in production.

backend/streaming.py get_ingress correctly swallows LiveKit errors and returns {configured:true, ingress:null, error:'Could not reach LiveKit: ...'}; frontend ObsStudioPanel renders obs-load-error for the HTTP-level failure (spinner cleared) and obs-livekit-error inside the configured-but-no-ingress branch — both paths visible with obs-retry-btn / obs-create-key-btn respectively. Nice.
test_credentials: wallowner@test.com / Test1234 (owner, can_stream, has stream key IN_5RPVSsN5K6gY); wallauthor@test.com / Test1234 (handle=author, can_stream now unset again; a stream_ingress row IN_c66iYma5ysbp was created in LiveKit+Mongo during the test and left in place per instructions).
seed_data_creation: Temporarily set profiles.can_stream=true on handle 'author' for test, unset after test. Author stream_ingress + LiveKit ingress IN_c66iYma5ysbp left behind as allowed by review request. Deleted one stale LiveKit ingress (skali-skalitester, IN_YV9vmigpk5Rq) that had no mongo backing row to clear the LiveKit object limit so a fresh create could succeed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Owner's ingress IN_5RPVSsN5K6gY must not be deleted (user explicitly asked to preserve). LiveKit Cloud account allows a small number of ingress objects before 429 resource_exhausted — if a fresh create key test fails with 500 and backend logs show 'total ingress object limit exceeded', list ingresses via LiveKit SDK and delete the ones not in db.stream_ingress. Testids used: obs-studio-panel, obs-load-error, obs-retry-btn, obs-livekit-error, obs-create-key-btn, obs-url-value, obs-key-value, obs-signal-light, obs-signal-text. Token local storage key is 'cc_token'.
rca of the issue: No bug surfaced. Fix verified: when GET /api/stream/ingress HTTP-fails frontend renders obs-load-error with retry (no spinner); when backend returns {ingress:null, error:'Could not reach LiveKit…'} frontend renders obs-livekit-error alongside the Create stream key button; real author create-key flow produces rtmps:// url + waiting-for-OBS signal.
